rationale: Producer enqueues first then burst worker drains. Strategy: baseline 1-job path, then max concurrency with fast poll/schedule to force concurrent dequeue SKIP LOCKED races and duplicate/lost active transitions, then max_burst_jobs truncation equal to concurrency and equal to jobs to test burst-counter races, then schedule=3600 with short dequeue_timeout to force burst early-exit while jobs still new/unqueued, plus slow poll/schedule mixes to interleave schedule new->queued with dequeue queued->active and complete.
